svg.title: DeployCenter architecture
svg.desc: Two paths reach one Python orchestrator. Git path: a platform engineer pushes customers.yaml, GitHub Actions assumes an AWS role through OIDC and runs the orchestrator. Dashboard path: a developer uses the React dashboard, which calls the Flask API, which calls the orchestrator. The orchestrator sets up Route 53 records and EFS volumes, commits rendered manifests to per-customer branches and creates ArgoCD applications; ArgoCD watches the branches and syncs the customer clusters.
